hero.headline: Give once. Reshape a life. Then watch it happen.
hero.subhead: Heart TV partners fund scholarships, meet basic needs and carry the message of hope to souls, nations and the world.

gallery.caption: Food, carried in by hand
gallery.body: Volunteers bring maize flour, rice and beans into the hall — one sack at a time, one household at a time.

gallery.caption: Every seat, a family fed
gallery.body: Parcels are set beside each family before the service ends, so nobody has to queue, ask twice or go home empty.

gallery.caption: Parents who can feed their children again
gallery.body: Fifty-kilo bags of maize flour and cash support, handed to young families with babies still in arms.

gallery.caption: One mother, five children, one month secured
gallery.body: Beans, flour and a cash gift — enough to take the pressure off a household carrying more than it can hold.

gallery.caption: Flour, rice and cooking oil
gallery.body: A standard relief package: staples that last, chosen because they stretch furthest in a family kitchen.

gallery.caption: Cash placed directly in their hands
gallery.body: Some needs are not food. Rent, medicine and school fees are met with cash given straight to the family.
